data.asar: Apne 1BHK ka rent dekh kar rona aa sakta hai.
data.caption:
Bollywood ke sabse aalishan gharon ki keemat sunkar hosh udd jayenge! 🏠💸

🏰 Shah Rukh Khan ke Mannat ki keemat ₹300 crore aanki gayi hai.
🏢 Ranbir Kapoor ka Krishna Raj bungalow ₹250 crore ka bataya gaya.
🛋️ Bollywood ke sabse mehange aashiyano ki list aayi saamne.

Yahan mahine ka 10 hazar rent dete waqt rooh kaanp jaati hai! 😂

Apne us dost ko tag karo jo sapno mein Mannat jaisa bangla lene ke plan banata hai! 👇
